lastCompletedStory.title: Replace the machine-wide watcher readiness gate with an own-watcher liveness proof

nextStoryContext: US-001 was the only non-operator story in this PRD (CAM-446). The fix touched ONLY test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts, per the story's notes: src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts was explicitly out of scope. The machine-wide `pgrep -f orch-recycle-watch` gate is gone; readiness is now proven by a WATCHER_READY_PROBE (arm the real ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER before the tmux wrapper exists, wait for the watcher's own consume-once tick to unlink it). Watcher stdout/stderr are captured via `Bun.spawn({ stdout: Bun.file(path), stderr: Bun.file(path) })` and folded (plus subprocess.exitCode) into the failure message of any watcher-liveness wait via a small `waitForWatcher` helper local to the test file. All CPU-contention prose removed, no flake-licensing prose introduced. Full suite (6017 tests) and `bun run check:all` are green; the target test itself was run 3x standalone to confirm determinism (no artificial load needed to reproduce green, per the story's measured root cause).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawn() stdout/stderr accept a Bun.file() sink to redirect output to a file, and that subprocess.exitCode is `number | null`, null while the process is still running. Implementation uses both exactly as documented.
